items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, affiliate, and data boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private; prohibit rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, deployment, configuration or credential changes, and external permission outreach pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics but not commercial/public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, image, price, trademark, affiliate, or advertising rights; public Woot terms restrict those uses. Compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner/consent/GA4 findings and privacy/terms findings. Analytics is yellow; operations and security sweeps are unavailable; Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and unattributed. Ordinary reversible growth is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry when existing boundaries remain unchanged. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch or monetization decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot documentation, public terms/support records, repository and configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task is closable because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, launch state, or send outreach.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Source access is evidenced, but public display, storage, caching, derivatives, alerts, images, prices, trademarks, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, affiliate, and advertising rights are not. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Purpose and operational processing are described, but data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are missing. Smallest next action: produce a read-only repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Measurement-only purpose and consent-gated intent are stated, but deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review are missing. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Operational purpose is stated, but log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures are missing. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory. No data-use item is clear for public beta on current evidence.

Site and launch disposition: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked and private. Their compliance reachability is unknown, analytics is not configured, and audience, traffic, revenue, attribution, health, security, and launch readiness remain unknown. No public launch, DNS, credentials, analytics, consent, tracking, affiliate, monetization, deployment, or launch-state change is supported. Existing repository-only evidence work may continue, but no task closes without dated ownership, exact before/after artifacts, deterministic validation, rollback evidence, and preserved parked/private status.
